name: aion-ts-plugin
description: AION - Time-Series Harness Plugin for OpenCode. Multi-agent orchestration with governance, leakage prevention, and experiment management.

scripts.build: bun run build:npm && bun run build:server && bun run build:tui && bun run build:cli
scripts.build:npm: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm
scripts.build:server: rm -f .opencode/plugins/aion.js && bun build src/index.ts --outfile .opencode/plugins/aion/server.js --target node --format esm
scripts.build:tui: bun build src/tui/index.tsx --outfile .opencode/plugins/aion/tui.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode/plugin/tui --external solid-js --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/solid --external @opencode/theme
scripts.build:cli: bun build bin/aion-init.js --outdir dist/bin --target node --format esm
scripts.dev: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --watch
scripts.test: bun run build:server && bun run build:tui && node --test test/unit/*.test.mjs test/cli/init.test.mjs

author: ztxtech
